description.narrative: (Nigeria): With FY 2022 funds this activity will:Scale-up TB screening services, including screening with digital x-rays with computer-aided detection software, in targeted settings informed by hotspot mapping;Engage various categories of formal and informal private health care providers for TB service delivery;Expand access to quality TB diagnostic services including TB molecular testing;Provide treatment for TB patients and support them to complete treatment and get cured;Improve access to quality, person-centered TB preventive therapy among persons at increased risk of developing TB disease; and Support efforts at mobilising domestic resources for TB services. In collaboration with the Government of Nigeria, respective state ministries of health, relevant government agencies, the formal and informal private health sector, and community structures this activity supports the national response for TB control in Lagos, Osun, Oyo, and Ogun states to improve access to TB preventive, diagnostic, treatment, and care services. This activity will provide a platform to expand TB care in target states including hard-to-reach and underserved areas; and among all population groups; and leverage its TB networks to facilitate equitable access to COVID-19 vaccines for eligible persons in two states. This activity contributes directly to USAID Nigeria CDCS Development Objective 2 and is closely aligned with Goal 1 of the 2022-2026 Joint Strategic Plan...
